scope: Windows portable ZIP extracted into a fresh short directory, no node_modules, bundled Node; real offline SDK execution, no model or public transaction

checks.name: all extracted release-manifest byte counts and SHA-256 hashes
fresh portable directory contains no node_modules
portable runtime, independent SDK runtime and GUI assets are present
release version and build hash agree
embedded build inputs and output hashes match extracted files
bundled Node starts the original platform health endpoint
independent BNB health exposes four bounded scenarios
all dedicated GUI and shared stylesheet assets are served
portable real SDK worker starts with independent run id
real local SDK signing and budget scenario completes successfully
real signature verification evidence is hydrated
sealed bundle and all required raw and graph artifacts export
portable bundle excludes reusable signatures and raw wallet secrets
independent recheck passes without changing sealed raw files
original health remains available after independent SDK experiment
owned portable server shuts down cleanly

limitations: Initial extraction under a deeply nested workspace path exceeded Windows MAX_PATH; successful verification uses a short directory. Long-path-disabled Windows users should extract into a short path such as C:/Web3Lab.
